raw_segments.text: Hermione, Verily, you put me off with limber vows, but I though you would seek tea unsphere
the stars with oaths should yet say, sir, no going.
A lady's verily is as potent as a lord's.
Force me to keep you as a prisoner, not like a guest, so you shall pay your fees when you
How say you, my prisoner or my guest?
One of them you shall be.
